meta_analysis_systematic_review.name: Meta-analysis and Systematic Review
meta_analysis_systematic_review.description: Comprehensive evidence synthesis through systematic literature review and statistical meta-analysis

professional_context.background: Systematic reviews address clinical uncertainty by synthesizing all available evidence using rigorous methodology
professional_context.problem_or_goal: To provide comprehensive, unbiased evidence synthesis for clinical decision-making
workflow_steps: Research question formulation using PICO framework
Comprehensive literature search across multiple databases
Study screening using predefined inclusion/exclusion criteria
Quality assessment using validated tools (e.g., Cochrane RoB)
Sensitivity and subgroup analyses as appropriate

doctoral_v1.methodology: Shows mastery of systematic review methodology fundamentals
doctoral_v1.critical_thinking: Exhibits critical appraisal skills for study quality assessment
doctoral_v1.statistical_understanding: Understands complex statistical concepts in meta-analysis
doctoral_v1.academic_contribution: Contributes to evidence base through rigorous synthesis

clinical_research_v1.protocol_execution: Executes systematic review protocols with precision
clinical_research_v1.data_quality: Ensures high-quality data extraction and management
clinical_research_v1.team_collaboration: Works effectively within research team structure

medical_affairs_v1.therapeutic_expertise: Demonstrates deep understanding of therapeutic area
medical_affairs_v1.stakeholder_engagement: Engages with scientific community on evidence topics
medical_affairs_v1.medical_strategy: Supports medical strategy through robust evidence

health_ai_data_v1.data_curation: Curates high-quality structured data from literature
health_ai_data_v1.systematic_approach: Applies systematic methodology to data collection
health_ai_data_v1.quality_assurance: Implements robust quality control in data processes
health_ai_data_v1.analytical_rigor: Maintains analytical rigor in evidence synthesis

recommended_questions: Which databases did you search (PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, etc.)?
How many studies were included in the final analysis?
What inclusion/exclusion criteria did you use?
Which bias risk assessment tool did you apply (Cochrane RoB, etc.)?
What statistical software did you use for analysis?
What was your specific role in the screening process?
Was this work published or presented anywhere?
